page.overview:
Who is Vic Hoskins?

Victor "Vic" Hoskins was a major antagonist of Jurassic World. He was the leader of Jurassic World's private security force. Under his leadership, InGen developed advanced security measures that helped to protect the visitors from the dinosaurs and could also be used in wars. He met his end when the Velociraptor Delta cornered him in one of the Innovation Center's labs and failed to listen to his hand signals, instead choosing to rip him to shreds.

He served as one of the two main antagonists of Jurassic World (alongside the Indominus rex), an unseen antagonist of the Netflix spin-off Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous (specifically as an unseen antagonist of Season 1 and a posthumous antagonist of the following seasons), and a posthumous antagonist of both Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom and Jurassic World: Dominion.

Vic Hoskins once owned a stray wolf pup, which attacked his wife when she tried to stab him. He never had it euthanized.

Hoskins joined the InGen Security Division sometime before 2001 as a security contractor. When the three Pteranodons that had escaped the Isla Sorna Aviary at the end of the Isla Sorna Incident of 2001 reached Canada, Hoskins oversaw the "clean up" of the adult Pteranodons.
